# implicitOp='*' (pattern has T, target has *T) and matched expression
# is &S{} (bare UnaryExpr, not in parens). The * and & cancel.
ex {
	var x S
	x.F -> NewF(x)
}
-- file.go --
package m

type S struct{ F int }

func NewF(s S) int { return s.F + 1 }

func example() {
	_ = (&S{F: 1}).F
}
-- stdout --
diff old/file.go new/file.go
--- old/file.go
+++ new/file.go
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@
 func NewF(s S) int { return s.F + 1 }

 func example() {
-	_ = (&S{F: 1}).F
+	_ = NewF(S{F: 1})
 }
